name: Thermenabend am Stubenbach
beschreibung:
=== description ===
The **Naturtherme Stubenbach** invites you to a relaxing evening under the open sky. Nestled in the landscape, thermal pools filled with soothing **38°C warm water** encourage you to linger. A herbal ceremony with infusion from native mountain herbs and a warming herbal tea complete the experience. Plus, breathtaking starlit skies.
